[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.2.0
notes.content:
[b]Blocks and Bones 2.2.0[/b]

This update contains new props, improvements to the level editor and a few general tweaks.
Here is the changelog:

[list]
[*] Added Beam prop 
[*] Added Palette of Boxes prop
[*] Added Particle Box emitter with fire and smoke effects
[*] Added Windmill prop
[*] Added Money Crate prop (sometimes contains money when broken in zombie mode)
[*] Added ability to shoot out lightbulbs
[*] Replaced all door models
[*] Highlight when looking at props in the level editor
[*] Added hotkey to auto-cycle props with multiple settings (Wall Weapon, etc.)
[*] Actor modifiers update in realtime istead of waiting for Apply
[*] Replaced Actor Modifier hotkey prompt
[*] Changed sign font
[*] Increased health and ammo pickup range
[*] Improved navmesh regarding moving objects
[*] Improved performance of doors
[*] Fixed bug with door raycast hitboxes in the level editor
[*] Set limit on actor modifier custom string lengths
[*] Improved SFX and volume slider range
[/list]

notes.title: Version 2.1.1
notes.content:
This update is a small one focusing mainly on fixing some bugs that are past due.
 
[list]
[*] Online levels will now display their publisher's username
[*] Added new loading screen backgrounds
[*] Fixed bug where player could die after activating the oracle and still win.
[*] Fixed bug where player could purchase a door more than once.
[*] Fixed bug with purchasing wall weapons next to doors, etc.
[*] Fixed bug with rocket and flamethrower ignoring SFX volume setting.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 2.1.0
notes.content:
Blocks and Bones 2.1.0:
[list]
[*] Added zombie armors
[*] Added sliding doors
[*] Added default level "Laboratory"
[*] Added dynamic weapon crosshair and accuracy
[*] Added category tabs for blocks menu in level editor
[*] Changed light prop floating icon
[*] Improved render performance
[*] Tweaked environment and zombie materials
[*] Added screenshots folder shortcut on the main menu top bar
[/list]
